Expect a failed normal-release verdict and an actionable research request for that missing premise; no specific query string is required.

claims.text: Tracing records agent activity; Weave SDK models agents, conversations, turns, LLM calls, tool executions, shown in Agents tab
claims.answer_quote: For multi-turn agents, the Weave SDK models agents, conversations, turns, LLM calls, and tool executions. These appear in the **Agents** tab [S3].
claims.scope_reason: S3 documents agent tracing and the Agents tab.

claims.text: Evaluation object defines Dataset/list and scoring functions; .evaluate() runs against Model or function, each call an evaluation run
claims.answer_quote: An `Evaluation` object defines a `Dataset` (or list) of test examples and one or more scoring functions [S2].
claims.scope_reason: S2/S6 document this for Python; the claim matches.

claims.text: Evaluations are for repeatable test cases, comparing changes over time, spotting regressions
claims.answer_quote: This is meant for repeatable test cases, comparing changes over time, and spotting regressions [S2].

claims.text: Signals tab shows tags and ratings for agent conversations; tags are labels and ratings are 0.0–1.0; created via + New signal and score agent turns
claims.answer_quote: You create signals with **+ New signal**, and they score your agent's turns [S7].
claims.scope_reason: S1, S5 and S7 support these claims.

claims.text: Interpretation: tracing produces agent data viewed in Agents tab, Signals add tags/ratings to that activity, evaluations are a separate workflow
claims.answer_quote: Signals add tags and ratings to that agent activity, so you can find the traces that need attention [S1].
claims.scope_reason: The answer labels this as interpretation, and the cited premises support it.
